classification: Development diagnostic; closed-loop inference interventions on fixed checkpoints, not newly trained policies.

modes.full: Unchanged deterministic prediction from this branch's current observation.
modes.common_wheels: Replace prediction[4:] by their common average; preserve prediction[:4].

comparison: For each saved model compare zero/full/zero_legs/common_wheels at their minimum recorded duration, retaining separate full-duration termination and completion statistics.
checks: All model and metadata hashes agree with the original development evaluation copies.
All 77 frozen source hashes agree before and after execution.
All branches start from identical observations, qpos, qvel and episode metadata.
Replay each fixed policy on the saved observations from its own branch and validate the saved predictions.
Validate action intervention, executed action, and subsequent previous-action observation.
Check fresh full-mode observations, state arrays and predictions against the previous same-condition full episodes.
Recompute common-prefix velocity, yaw-rate, height, heading and lateral-displacement metrics from original recorded data.
interpretation: A branch improvement can implicate the removed action component in this closed-loop setting. Coupled state changes prevent interpreting the contrasts as additive independent physical contributions. No training or final-evaluation claim follows from this diagnostic.
